name: ostrelio-agent-plugins
description: Ostrelio's agent integrations: harness hook plugins (omp, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Windsurf), the connect CLI, the MCP gateway and the TypeScript SDK.

scripts.test: npm run test:plugins && npm run test:codex
scripts.test:plugins: for p in agent-guard omp-plugin claude-code-plugin codex-plugin cursor-plugin gemini-cli-plugin windsurf-plugin connect; do npm test --prefix packages/$p || exit 1; done
